Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source: compound_structures, molecule_dictionary, activities. Join: molecule_dictionary on compound_structures.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno, activities on molecule_dictionary.molregno = activities.molregno. Filter: activities.assay_id = (SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1054500'), activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL, activities.standard_relation = '='. Sort: canonical_smiles ASC, chembl_id ASC, standard_type ASC, standard_relation ASC, standard_value ASC, standard_units ASC.
